pr_title: Mention that default spawned primary window is spawned with `PrimaryWindow` marker component
pr_body:
# Objective

Fixes #8751 

## Solution

The doc string for the `primary_window` field on `Window` now mentions that the default spawned primary window is spawned with the `PrimaryWindow` marker component.

issue_context.title: Mention that default primary window is spawned with the `PrimaryWindow` marker component
issue_context.body:
## How can Bevy's documentation be improved?

The docs for [`Window`](http://dev-docs.bevyengine.org/bevy/prelude/struct.WindowPlugin.html#structfield.primary_window) tell us how a primary window will be created by default if some settings are provided. 

It would be helpful if they also mentioned that this window is bundled with marker component [`PrimaryWindow`](http://dev-docs.bevyengine.org/bevy/window/struct.PrimaryWindow.html), which is useful to know for those wishing to query for it.
